# Integration Notes

## Organizational Identity

The application is expected to use the existing identity service for sign-in.
The identity team believes employee number and department are available.
Manager relationships and preferred language have not been confirmed.

## Messaging

The internal messaging service may send request, approval, cancellation, and
reminder notifications. Available templates, delivery tracking, and rate
limits are unknown.

## Calendar

Stakeholders want approved sessions to appear in personal calendars. The
calendar team has not confirmed whether the project may create, update, or
remove entries.

## People Data

Training operations expects department and location data from the people
directory. Ownership, refresh frequency, and treatment of missing values have
not been agreed.

No interface contract or API documentation has been supplied.
